gold_requirements.text: The system shall allow users to transfer assets between departments.
The system shall allow authorized users to edit asset information.
The system shall allow users to modify asset fields except for IDs.
The system shall support bulk entry of assets.
The system shall allow authorized users to add inventory assets.
The system shall allow users to create requests to borrow an asset or reserve a space.
The system shall allow IT group members to create new spaces.
The system shall allow authorized users to approve or reject pending requests.
The system shall notify users via email when a request is treated.
The system shall authenticate users via username and password.
The system shall allow administrative users to delegate permissions to other users.
The system shall generate reports on assets by location, requests, and user permissions.
The system learning time must be between 2 to 4 hours maximum.
The web interface must use clear and consistent terminology.
The application must be available during all working hours.
The application must be installable on Microsoft or Unix platforms.
The web application must run on IE, Firefox, Chrome, Opera, or Safari browsers.
The system must assign permissions to users according to their roles.
Only IT team members shall access and maintain database servers locally.
The system must terminate any database query that takes more than 1 minute.
The system must perform backup operations periodically.
The system should be designed in a way to facilitate future evolution and maintenance operations
